title: 0005 断头饭0006 断头饭2
content_zh:
“你擅自挪用了香火税为百姓降雨，缓解了旱情，拯救了万千苍生性命，就这个行为本身来说是对的，且值得称道。
可你为此魂飞魄散，换了一位新城隍，再遇到此类情况怕是就不敢照做了。人也好、妖也好、仙鬼也罢，怕死是天性。你的行为对后人的威慑大于鼓励，起不到改变现状的作用。
就像是一位将军遇到劲敌时不管双方实力差距几何，只知道猛冲猛打，战死也就战死了，对战局无益，还连累了诸多兵卒，愚勇也！”
如果洪涛是第一次回到古代，遇到这种事百分百会坚定地站在城隍一边，咬牙切齿的骂皇帝昏庸、骂大臣尸位素餐草菅人命。然而经过这么多次穿越，对现代和古代社会有了更深刻的了解之后就不会轻易站队了。
殷云霄遇到的情况并不是个例，靠单打独斗无异于鸡蛋碰石头，甚至连激励后人的作用都微乎其微。因为舆论掌控在对立面手里，除了极少的当事人之外，大部分获救的百姓甚至都不知道恩人是谁。
从微观上讲，殷云霄没错，确实救了成千上万生命，让治下百姓能在秋季获得足够的粮食，不至于在严冬时节挨饿。
但从宏观上看，这种方式对改变整体局面基本无用，还不如搞次轰轰烈烈的抗税或者抢粮行动。
反正最终都是一死，悄无声息的被处死在镇妖殿诏狱中毫无意义，战死在沙场上却能让更多人知道真相，搞好了还能让朝廷肉疼，哪个效果好一目了然。
“难不成就让殷某眼睁睁看着治下百姓饥肠辘辘饿殍遍野！”对于行刑力士地这番言论殷云霄本能的抵触，自己好歹也做了善事，怎么被说得如此不堪呢？
“能问出这句话说明你两世为官仍没参透这套体系的核心，不是愚又是什么？别忘了你是官，做官就要遵守规则，不能想怎么样就怎么样。
重要的不是对错，而是维护体系运转。如果所有官员都像你这样随心所欲还要朝廷何用？如果换你来当皇帝，遇见这样的官又该如何处置？”
顶嘴是吧？这下洪涛可就不发愁了，至少暂时把其余的事儿先抛开，必须从理论上驳倒对方，否则这辈子都耿耿于怀。
“……要是换做你来当城隍又该如何？”殷云霄像是被问住了，绕不开这个逻辑顺序，开始沉思，盏茶之后反问了回来。
“两个办法！”洪涛早就做好了被设身处地的准备，马上伸出了两根手指，同时也没忘探头再看看通道。
很多人说不过对方时就会反问回去，如果也没有答案至少说明自己没错，心里就舒服多了。可惜今天遇到了自己，舒服是不可能的，会不会被气死难说。
“要不继续为官，遵守规则，试图在规则之内找到解决办法。要不放弃官身，跳出规则寻找别的解决办法。不管怎么选，我都不会和你一样。
事情到了这个地步，真不是解决一个县百姓疾苦的问题了。有道是冰冻三尺非一日之寒，你在严冬的冰面上自己把自己烧了，换来些许热量救助一只快冻死的鸟，明智吗？
等你烧光了，该多冷还是多冷，那只鸟能多活一会儿。可若是它找不到适合生存的地方，很快还是要被冻死的。却白白损失了一个有能力改变更多的人，是对是错你应该能想明白吧？”
“……想不到我殷某竟如此愚蠢，好在道消魂散之前还能听到忠言也算值了。只是不知先生名讳，能否告知？”
这次殷云霄沉默的时间更长了，再说话时语气和腔调都有了明显不同，大概率是听懂并认可了，甚至连称呼也有了变化。

“洪水的洪，波涛的涛。也不要太心灰意冷，大人的所作所为不全是无用功，至少镇妖殿的玄鸟卫们在心里是认同的，这才没在途中施虐。
刚刚鲁王殿下也来过了，特意安排洪某一个人审讯。再加上个洪某，说不定还能流芳百世呢。人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青啊。”
你敬我一尺，我敬你一丈是洪涛一贯的行事风格。见到城隍被说服了，还能称呼自己为先生，马上又觉得把一位将死之人毕生认为自豪的做为大加贬低有些过分，赶紧往回找补。
“……人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青？佳句啊！不知出自何处，又是何人所作？”殷云霄确实听了劝，情绪有了明显好转，但不是因为鲁王和流芳百世的可能性，而是来自一句诗。
“呃……洪某不才，虽未有功名却也读过些诗词，偶有感触班门弄斧，大人莫怪！”说话喜欢引经据典也是穿越后遗症，好在对方是个将死之人，实话实说无妨，毕竟骗鬼有点太损了。
“哦？洪先生大才！不知令尊……”如果说一名皂吏能评点江山社稷已经让殷云霄很意外了，那皂吏还能出口成诗，哪怕只有一句，就得是匪夷所思了。
可不信还不成，他已经活了两辈子，还都喜欢读书，加一起大几十年，不敢说博览群书，反正大夏境内但凡有点名气的书籍肯定不会漏，其中百分百没有这句诗。
“洪某是接了父辈的班才进入镇妖殿当差。”洪涛能理解殷城隍的心情，索性就不介绍已故的老爹了，说了也没用，他好像认字也不太多，更不可能作诗。
“呵呵呵……如此说来先生此句是有感而发，专因老夫而作了？”
听闻此言殷云霄并没失望，反而笑了起来。只是他这副肉身选得有些差，不光长得猥琐，声音还那么不中听，笑起来快赶上夜猫子叫了。
“不敢当，触景生情罢了。”人家都认定了洪涛也懒得矫情，拱拱手客气客气算是认了。
“好！好一个触景生情，当浮一大白……此处可有水酒？可否陪我这个将死之魂聊聊？”没想到老城隍还起劲儿了，不光要继续聊下去还想喝酒。
“酒倒是有，不知大人能否……实不相瞒，洪某在这里十几年了，亲手送走过诸多修士妖魔，唯独没与仙人相处过。”
诏狱里不光有酒还有荤素菜肴，都是给囚犯准备的。如果能用些许享受就让他们配合审讯，谁也不愿意弄得鬼哭狼嚎。可洪涛不得不提醒对方一下您是魂魄啊，鬼魂喝酒尝得出滋味吗？
“无妨，此肉身虽是禁锢却也有凡人感识……”殷云霄看着迷迷瞪瞪的洪涛又笑了起来。
他是真想不明白，如此一个懵懵懂懂，连很多常识都搞不清的皂吏为何能说出那般道理，还能出口成诗。不过有件事他好像想明白了，碰上这个皂吏应该是来自上天的眷顾，是让自己弥补遗憾的。
“今日大人好运气，不光有鸡和鱼还有羊肉。老大人请……”
洪涛哪儿知道自己要被个将死的鬼魂算计，走到通道出口的值房挑了几样硬菜和一壶酒回来，亲自给城隍斟满，又给自己倒了一杯。
作为狱卒他本不该吃这些酒菜，毕竟是给囚犯准备的，太晦气。可此洪涛非彼洪涛，对于诸多禁忌全当个屁。反正也不是诏狱的规定，别说是囚犯的饭菜，就是临死的断头饭和送魂酒，只要想了照吃不误，爱谁谁！
“同饮！”此时的殷云霄已经没了将死之人的落寞，一举一动比洪涛还豪爽，仰脖喝光杯中酒，抓起卤羊肉就往嘴里塞。本来就不太顺溜的胡子，这么一搞直接成拖布了。
content_en:
"You used the incense tax without authorization to provide rain for the people, alleviate the drought, and save the lives of thousands of people. This act itself is right and commendable.
But you were so devastated by this that you found a new city god. If you encounter such a situation again, you may not dare to do it. Be it human beings, monsters, fairies or ghosts, it is natural to fear death. Your actions will deter future generations more than encourage them, and will not change the status quo.
Just like when a general encounters a powerful enemy, regardless of the strength gap between the two sides, he only knows how to rush and fight, and if he dies in battle, he will die in battle. It is not helpful to the battle situation and also involves many soldiers. How foolish and brave! "
If Hong Tao had returned to ancient times for the first time, he would definitely stand firmly on the side of the city god when encountering this kind of thing, gnashing his teeth and scolding the emperor for being stupid and scolding the ministers for not caring about human life. However, after traveling through so many times and gaining a deeper understanding of modern and ancient society, we will not easily take sides.
The situation that Yin Yunxiao encountered is not an exception. Fighting alone is like throwing an egg against a rock, and it even has little effect on inspiring future generations. Because public opinion is controlled by the opposite party, except for a few parties involved, most of the rescued people do not even know who the benefactor is.
From a microscopic perspective, Yin Yunxiao was right. He indeed saved thousands of lives, allowing the people under his rule to have enough food in the autumn and not starve in the harsh winter.
But from a macro perspective, this approach is basically useless in changing the overall situation. It would be better to engage in a vigorous tax resistance or grain grab operation.
In the end, he died anyway. Being executed silently in the Demon Suppression Palace's prison was meaningless. Death on the battlefield would allow more people to know the truth. If done well, it would also make the court feel painful. It was clear which one had the better effect.
"Is it possible for Yin to watch the people under his rule starving and dying all over the place!" Yin Yunxiao instinctively resisted the execution warrior's remarks. After all, he had done good deeds, so why was he said so badly?
"The fact that you can ask this question shows that you have been an official for two lifetimes and still haven't understood the core of this system. What else is it if it's not stupidity? Don't forget that you are an official. To be an official, you must abide by the rules. You can't just do whatever you want.
The important thing is not right or wrong, but maintaining the operation of the system. What's the use of the court if all officials do whatever they want like you? If you were the emperor, how would you deal with such an official? "
Talking back, right? Now Hong Tao doesn't have to worry, at least for the time being, he puts aside other things. He must refute the other party theoretically, otherwise he will be worried about it for the rest of his life.
"...What if you were the city god instead?" Yin Yunxiao seemed to be puzzled by the question. He couldn't avoid this logical sequence and began to think deeply. After drinking tea, he asked back.
"Two ways!" Hong Tao was already prepared to be put in his shoes, and immediately stretched out two fingers, while not forgetting to look at the passage again.
Many people will ask back when they cannot answer the other party's question. If there is no answer, at least it means that they are right, which makes them feel much better. It's a pity that I met myself today. It's impossible to feel comfortable. It's hard to say whether I will be mad to death.
"Either I continue to be an official, abide by the rules, and try to find solutions within the rules. Or I give up my official position, go beyond the rules and find other solutions. No matter what I choose, I will not be the same as you.
When things have reached this point, it is no longer a matter of solving the sufferings of the people in the county. There is a saying that three feet of ice does not freeze in a day. Is it wise to burn yourself on the ice in the harsh winter in exchange for some heat to save a bird that is about to freeze to death?
When you burn out, no matter how cold it is, the bird can live a little longer. But if it can't find a suitable place to survive, it will soon freeze to death. But you have lost a person who has the ability to change more. You should be able to figure out whether it is right or wrong, right? "
"...I never thought that I, Yin, could be so stupid. Fortunately, I could still hear the words before they disappeared.The advice is worth it. I just don’t know your name, can you tell me? "
This time, Yin Yunxiao was silent for a longer time. When he spoke again, his tone and tone were obviously different. He most likely understood and acknowledged it, and even his title changed.
“flood upon flood, wave upon wave. Don't be too disheartened. What you did was not all in vain. At least the black bird guards of the Demon Suppressing Hall agreed in their hearts, so they didn't torture you on the way.
His Royal Highness King Lu also came here just now and specially arranged for Hong to be interrogated by someone. With the addition of Mr. Hong, he might even be famous for generations to come. Since ancient times, no one has died, leaving a loyal heart to illuminate history. "
You respect me a foot, and I respect you a foot. This is Hong Tao's consistent style. Seeing that Cheng Huang was persuaded and could still call himself sir, he immediately felt that it was too much to belittle the deeds that a dying man was proud of throughout his life, so he quickly went back to make amends.
"...Since ancient times, who has never died and left a loyal heart to illuminate history? What a wonderful sentence! I don’t know where it came from and who made it? "Yin Yunxiao did listen to the advice and his mood improved significantly, but it was not because of King Lu and the possibility of lasting fame, but because of a poem.
"Uh... Hong is not talented. Although he has no fame, he has read some poems and occasionally feels that he is a master of his own craft. Don't blame me! "I like to quote scriptures when speaking, which is also a sequelae of time travel. Fortunately, the other party is a dying person, so it doesn't hurt to tell the truth. After all, it is too damaging to lie to ghosts.
"Oh? Mr. Hong is a great talent! I don't know, sir..." If Yin Yunxiao was surprised that a Zaoli could comment on the state of the country, then it was incredible that a Zaoli could write a poem, even just one sentence.
But it’s not true if you don’t believe it. He has lived two lifetimes, and he still likes to read. He is a few decades old together, and he dare not say that he is well-read. Anyway, there are definitely no books with some reputation in Daxia, and this poem is 100% not included.
"Hong entered the Demon Suppression Hall as an errand after taking over from his father. "Hong Tao could understand Yin Chenghuang's mood, so he simply didn't introduce his late father. It was useless. He didn't seem to know much about words, let alone write poetry.
"Hahaha... So this sentence was inspired by my feelings, and was written specifically for me? "
After hearing this, Yin Yunxiao was not disappointed, but laughed. It's just that his physical body was a bit poorly chosen. Not only did he look wretched, but his voice was also so unpleasant that when he laughed, he almost screamed like a night owl.
"I don't dare to take it seriously, it's just a matter of touching the scene. "Everyone has concluded that Hong Tao is too lazy to be pretentious, so he just bows his hands and is polite and accepts it.
"Okay! I was so moved by the scene that I suddenly realized... Is there any water or wine here? Can you chat with this dying soul of mine? "Unexpectedly, the old Chenghuang was still excited. Not only did he want to continue chatting, he also wanted to drink.
"I have some wine, I wonder if your lord can... To be honest, Hong has been here for more than ten years, and has personally sent away many monks and demons, but he has never dealt with an immortal. "
There were not only wine but also meat and vegetable dishes in the prison, all prepared for the prisoners. If you can get them to cooperate with the interrogation with a little enjoyment, no one would want to make the ghosts cry and howl. But Hong Tao had to remind the other party that you are a soul. Can ghosts taste the taste of drinking alcohol?
"It doesn't matter, although this body is imprisoned, it still has the feelings of a mortal..." Yin Yunxiao looked at Hong Tao, who was staring in confusion, and laughed again.
He really couldn't understand how such a ignorant official who couldn't even understand a lot of common sense could speak such truth and write poems out of it. However, he seemed to have figured out one thing. Meeting this soap official should be a blessing from God, allowing him to make up for his regrets.
"My lord, you are very lucky today. We have not only chicken and fish but also mutton. Sir, please..."
Little did Hong Tao know that he was about to be plotted by a dying ghost, so he walked to the check-in room at the exit of the passage and picked out a few hard dishes and a jug of wine. He filled it up for the city god himself and poured himself another glass.
as jailerHe shouldn't have eaten these food and drinks. After all, they were prepared for prisoners. It was too unlucky. But one big wave is not that big wave, and all the taboos are ignored. Anyway, it is not a regulation of the prison. Not to mention the food for prisoners, it is the decapitation meal and soul wine before death. As long as you think about it, you can eat it and love whoever you want!
"Drink together!" At this time, Yin Yunxiao no longer felt lonely as a dying person, and every move he made was even bolder than Hong Tao's. He raised his head and drank the wine in the glass, grabbed the braised mutton and stuffed it into his mouth. My beard, which was not very smooth to begin with, turned into a mop.
